# ARM memory-compiler macros of the KUL cluster overlay (tech/kul_tc_sram.sv), generated by
# flow/tsmc65/sram/mc_gen.sh gen impl/kulcluster/macros.txt (views host-local, see run.sh).
# <instance>  <compiler>  <words> <bits> <mux> [<option>=<value> ...]
# Choice (sweep.txt, ss 0.9 V 125 C, macro area incl. power ring):
#   512 x 64 byte-masked (TCDM bank, 32x): RF mux 4 53.0k um2 ta 1.24 ns (HD-SRAM mux 8 91.6k, mux 16 146.8k)
#   128 x 256 (icache data way, 2x): 2 x RF 128x128 mux 1 = 67.7k (4 x 128x64 mux 2 = 98.5k; HD-SRAM needs mux >= 8)
#   128 x 39 (icache tag way, 2x): RF 128x40 mux 1 17.2k, 1 bit padded (39 bits not legal; ~5k flops are larger)
kul_rf_512x64m4  rf_sp_adv 512  64 4 write_mask=on wp_size=8
kul_rf_128x128m1 rf_sp_adv 128 128 1
kul_rf_128x40m1  rf_sp_adv 128  40 1
